newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sells Canadian dollars - traders.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sells Canadian dollars - traders.

text.p: The Bank of Canada intervened on Tuesday and sold Canadian dollars for U.S. dollars as the currency traded around the C$1.3575 level, dealers said.
The intervention was through brokers and considered light as the currency strengthened through key resistance.
They said the central bank intervened to smooth out gains in the currency, but not to stop the Canadian dollar's recent trend toward stronger levels.
After intervention, Canada's dollar was trading at C$1.3579 after opening at C$1.3606 and Monday's close of C$1.3650. Traders expected further gains.
